How do I become a member?
Visit cbmnigeria.org/register and follow the national registration instructions.
Does this chapter website store membership information?
No. There is no membership form or member database on this website. Registration is completed on the national platform.
Where can I find my membership card or account?
Please use the national City Boy Movement website for account, identity verification and membership-card enquiries.
Are the listed programmes currently open?
The programme pages describe focus areas. Only confirmed announcements will state that a programme or event is open and explain how to participate.
Where are chapter contact details?
Visit the Contact page for chapter information and national enquiry routes.
How can I volunteer?
Start with national membership registration, then explore News & Events for participation guidance and chapter information.
Can I use the chapter logo?
Keep the supplied logo unchanged and follow the brand guideline. Obtain chapter approval for official materials before publication.
